beats.text: Good evening, this is Broken News. Tonight: forty thousand office chairs recalled for "spinning with intent".
Regulators say the chairs have been leaving desks unattended. Several were seen in a car park.
Ha! A chair can't hurt anyone, Philippa. I sit on danger every night.
Nobody threw it, Brock. It's a self-starter. Like you, apparently.
It came from YOUR side of the desk!

shouts.uk: IT'S A RECALL, NOT A WEAPON!

realStory.text: Nothing: this is a test episode for the rogue chair. No office chairs have been recalled for spinning with intent. Please continue sitting responsibly.
